description: Predict property values over time. Billed per predicted field, once for each date and each property. Required: property_id, start_date, fields. Find the property_id first with search_endpoint or properties_endpoint. Supports batch requests and parameter overrides for scenario testing.

ScenarioOverrides.description: What-if property changes accepted by both /avm and /predict.

garage_type_first.description: Garage type. Use field_detail on garage_type_first for accepted values.

property_type.description: Property type. Use field_detail on property_type for accepted values.

last.description: Periods before start_date to include. A range reaching before 2021-01-01 is refused

next.description: Periods after start_date to include. A range reaching past today is refused, because the models do not forecast

overrides.description: What-if changes to the property before predicting, for scenario testing. Anything left out keeps the property's real value.

price_quote.description: Return the cost of this request without billing it or returning data

property_id.description: Property ID(s), comma-separated for batch requests

start_date.description: Reference date in YYYY-MM-DD format, from 2021-01-01 to today

name: predict_endpoint
